research_question: Does a policy selected with authenticated randomized training and validation decision histories improve genuine future research selection gain-per-compute versus all four frozen native Dream-RSI exploration baselines?

preregistered_comparison.policy_engine: dreamrsi.Optimize / dreamrsi.AssessHoldout from frozen R27 source
preregistered_comparison.initial_baselines: four distinct dreamrsi.BasePolicies registered using the lane's frozen optimization source; policy and baselines must be frozen before sealed future outcomes
preregistered_comparison.policy_selection_rule: select exclusively on training and validation via the existing frozen dreamrsi.Optimize; never select using the holdout
preregistered_comparison.primary_comparison: dreamrsi.SafeImprovement against each of the four frozen policies on the same sealed heldout decisions
preregistered_comparison.gate: all five evaluated policies have genuine randomized support; holdout all comparable; existing effective-sample-size and action-support gates; provisional dominance against all four; independent causal/multiple-comparison review remains mandatory
preregistered_comparison.negative_rule: a negative or mixed valid original is preserved and never rerun; missing or indeterminate original consumes budget and is not declared a win
preregistered_comparison.compute_guardrail: existing owner-set preauthorized budget and GitHub-hosted workers only; no external paid API
preregistered_comparison.cross_lane_condition: cross-lane nonreuse must be verified by the owner for any independently accepted original, but an absent other lane cannot block read-only advisory assessment
